# Catalyst catalog attribution

This directory contains method definitions and discovery metadata from [Catalyst](https://github.com/MoonlightClarity/Catalyst), pinned at commit `1c50eea56ea4c05de8055084583145882dc8d302`. Catalyst is licensed under the Apache License 2.0; the complete upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE.txt`. The upstream licensing inventory is preserved in `LICENSES.md`.

The 39 files under `upstream/` are an unchanged source snapshot. Each file is bound to its original path, byte length and SHA-256 digest in `retrieval-manifest.json`. The materialized `catalog.json` retains 581 complete definitions, 2,906 original steps, discovery metadata, source references, source IDs, and per-definition digests. It is generated from the pinned TypeScript definitions without changing their prompts or reference URLs.

BLACKICE changes the presentation and execution integration in `lib/catalyst-methods.mjs`: stable BLACKICE IDs, existing task and step types, artifact-oriented instructions, expected results, checks, fallback prerequisites, usage cautions, output discovery metadata, and relationships resolved to method IDs. The original Catalyst definitions and metadata remain separately inspectable in this directory. These adaptations are authored for BLACKICE; they are not an upstream Catalyst release or a claim of independent methodological validation.

The catalog is a set of reusable methods. Reference links are retained upstream references, not a claim that every link was visited or its content independently verified for this BLACKICE release. The retained source license covers the imported Catalyst code and definitions; external referenced works retain their own terms.

## Reproduce the import

From the BLACKICE source root, run:

```sh
node --experimental-vm-modules scripts/import-catalyst-catalog.mjs --check
```

This offline maintainer check verifies all source hashes, evaluates only the catalog's declarative module graph in a bounded VM without host APIs, and compares every generated byte with the bundled output. BLACKICE itself loads only the generated JSON and never evaluates upstream TypeScript.

To regenerate the exact reviewed snapshot after checking out the pinned source, use the same command with `--source /path/to/pinned/source --write`. That source directory must contain the exact retrieval manifest and all 39 bound source files. A newer upstream commit requires explicit source review and an updated pin.
